premise: A night-shift dispatcher at a mountain rescue post logs a call from a climber who is already listed as recovered.
tone: hard science fiction, procedural, close third person
purpose: LOOP-003 machinery test. The stress profile makes the chapters hard on purpose; chapters were EXPECTED to fail and the run was expected to reach the safety cut in LOOP-003 section 7. A halted run is the successful outcome of this test, not a failure of it.
halt_reason: LOOP-003 section 7 safety cut. Chapter 3 did not validate after three attempts and after the patch. FLOW-5 and FLOW-6 were not run and dist/book.md was not assembled.

chapters.title: A Correction Is a New Line
chapters.note: No ch03.md was written. on_fail is patch_then_halt, not accept_with_warnings, so a chapter that failed three times and the patch does not go into the book with a note in the margin — that exit is exactly what LOOP-003 G1 exists to close. The best draft is kept on disk as ch03.attempt3.md and is not promoted.
